dataProvenance: All numerical/technical example policies are FICTIONAL_PRODUCT_NEUTRAL

processes.title: Camera coverage geometry
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
requiredInputs: camera captured position/frame and rotation matrix
rectilinear sensor width/height and focal length
processes.algorithm: Cast sensor corner rays through captured calibrated pinhole frame; intersect t=(planeOffset-dot(normal,origin))/dot(normal,direction), require positive finite intersection and supported model. Clip ordered footprint to zone. FOV=2*atan(sensorDimension/(2*focalLength)) uses separately versioned bounded backend; horizontal/vertical FOV bounds are mandatory technical dimensions; a footprint-only result cannot qualify the complete process. Parallel/horizon/uncertain intersections remain unresolved. No DORI or occlusion success inferred.
processes.positiveOracle: Fictional normal incidence: height=3m,sensor=6x4mm,focal=6mm,target parallel plane -> footprint 3x2m, area 6m2; unobstructed geometry basis only. Required angle bounds: horizontal FOV in(.9272952180,.9272952181)rad and vertical in(.6435011087,.6435011089)rad.
processes.negativeCase: Unsupported fisheye/occlusion model or horizon-parallel ray -> BLOCKED; geometric footprint is not visible-through-wall coverage. Missing bounded angle backend blocks complete CCTV-01 qualification.

processes.title: Stream bandwidth
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
requiredInputs: directed forwarding/recorder subscriptions and unicast/multicast policy
processes.algorithm: Sum encoded stream bitrate times explicit copies on each traversed network edge. Unicast subscriptions generate separate copies; multicast dedup requires declared distribution tree. Recorder ingress counts only assigned incoming streams. Expected/peak remain separate; codec/resolution/fps do not synthesize bitrate without a versioned model.
processes.positiveOracle: One 4,000,000bit/s stream, two unicast receivers on common edge -> 8,000,000bit/s edge load; one recorded subscription -> 4,000,000bit/s recording ingress.
processes.negativeCase: Missing peak bitrate leaves peak dimension unresolved; a repeated system membership does not create an extra encoded stream.

processes.title: Recording storage
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
requiredInputs: union of half-open recorded UTC intervals over explicit horizon
reserve multiplier and optional redundancy profile
explicit storage pool/copy identity and integer-byte rounding policy
processes.algorithm: For each unique recording assignment integrate bitrateBitsPerSecond * uniqueRecordedSeconds / 8; sum and apply declared reserve once. Daily recurrence is expanded with pinned timezone/rules, then overlaps are unioned; do not multiply total horizon seconds by retentionDays again. Raw estimate=usableRequired/redundancyUsableFraction only if explicit model applies; no product selection. Сначала суммировать точные rational bytes всех уникальных recording assignments в одном storage pool/horizon, затем применить reserve один раз и ceil до целого usable byte. Raw basis=ceil(rounded usable/redundancy fraction). UI rounding не меняет ни один verdict. Явный sizingBasis EXPECTED_ESTIMATE либо GUARANTEED_UPPER_BOUND. Для guarantee интегрировать подтверждённый upper-bound bitrate/schedule model; missing bound ->UNRESOLVED. Estimate может пройти только estimate-capacity и всегда retentionGuarantee=NOT_ASSESSED. Recording identity=(streamId,poolId,copyRole); duplicate identity rejected; two deliberate pools/copies counted explicitly.
processes.positiveOracle: 8,000,000bit/s continuous 30*86400s -> 2,592,000,000,000B; reserve1.1 -> 2,851,200,000,000B. Explicit mirror usable fraction .5 -> raw basis5,702,400,000,000B.
processes.negativeCase: Overlapping intervals counted once; absent event duty or schedule/timezone policy blocks affected estimate, never assume 24h or a motion factor. Expected estimate never qualifies guaranteed retention; one-bit recording tests byte rounding.

processes.title: CCTV PoE context
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Bind CCTV subject/policy and contribution to the global PWR-06 budget. Reuse exact matching physical evaluation; do not rerun a reduced CCTV-only source or add cable allowance/reserve again.
processes.positiveOracle: Global shared reservation30W, budget35W, selected CCTV contribution12W -> global margin5W, contribution12W; exactly one physical budget evidence.
processes.negativeCase: LAN contribution18W cannot disappear under CCTV filter; stale/mismatched physical evidence -> BLOCKED.

processes.title: Recorder/VMS capacity
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
requiredInputs: channel/license accounting basis and exact grouping key
storage sizing claim required by selected policy
processes.algorithm: Check distinct recorded channel count, peak ingress, declared stream compatibility and required usable storage independently. Selected usable capacity is not raw disk sum. Capacity failure is a completed FAIL, not an execution error. Recorder profile explicitly selects accounting basis DEVICE, ENCODED_STREAM or LICENSE_CHANNEL with exact assignments. Enforce each declared channel/license capacity separately. Sum actual ingress and recordings independently of channel grouping. Missing accounting basis ->BLOCKED. Явный sizingBasis EXPECTED_ESTIMATE либо GUARANTEED_UPPER_BOUND. Для guarantee интегрировать подтверждённый upper-bound bitrate/schedule model; missing bound ->UNRESOLVED. Estimate может пройти только estimate-capacity и всегда retentionGuarantee=NOT_ASSESSED. Recording identity=(streamId,poolId,copyRole); duplicate identity rejected; two deliberate pools/copies counted explicitly.
processes.positiveOracle: 2 assigned channels, declared4-channel limit, ingress8Mbps<=20Mbps and required2,851,200,000,000B<=3,000,000,000,000 usable B -> PASS.
processes.negativeCase: Enough channels with insufficient usable storage -> storage FAIL; missing codec support is unresolved, not compatible by label.

processes.title: CCTV cable/link basis
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Check medium/interface/category and installed link composition against explicit policy limits. If powered, reference matching scoped PWR-06 result; preserve per-segment power applicability. Never use room distance or duplicate cable allocations.
processes.positiveOracle: Fictional copper policy maximum30m, realized28m+2m patches=30m -> length basis PASS with exact profile provenance.
processes.negativeCase: Fiber without powered media converter cannot satisfy PoE path; unknown route -> physical dimension BLOCKED.

processes.title: Permanent-link and channel length
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Sum permanent-link sections and patch cords separately; total channel is their union. Installed length already includes declared service loops/allowances, so add only explicit not-yet-included contributions. Compare independent permanent/channel limits from policy.
processes.positiveOracle: Permanent28m + explicit patches2m = channel30m; policy permanent<=28/channel<=30 -> PASS, no second service-loop addition.
processes.negativeCase: Duplicate section membership or unknown length basis -> unresolved/invalid; no universal hardcoded 90/100m limit.

processes.title: Switch port capacity
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Count distinct occupied compatible physical ports; spare requirement=ceil(occupied*ratio) under declared policy. Check occupied+requiredSpare<=available; pre-reserved physical ports are set members, not an extra duplicate load. Break down incompatible assignments.
processes.positiveOracle: 6 occupied,8 available,ratio .25 -> ceil1.5=2 spare,required8,margin0 -> PASS.
processes.negativeCase: 7 occupied with same policy -> 2 spare,required9>8 FAIL; same port assigned twice is not two available ports.

processes.title: LAN PoE context
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Contextualize global PWR-06 evidence and LAN contribution without a second electrical source graph, repeated losses or reduced membership totals.
processes.positiveOracle: Global30W, selected LAN18W,35W budget -> margin5W with same physical evidence as CCTV-04.
processes.negativeCase: Conflicting source-owned reserve/mode policy -> explicit policy conflict; never choose a discipline default silently.

processes.title: Copper compatibility basis
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Evaluate every ordered path section against the selected speed/media/connector/shielding/category policy. Minimum path capability is the limiting section, not cable label alone. Keep declared technical policy matching separate from normative certification.
processes.positiveOracle: Every section explicitly supports selected1Gb/s fixture profile and length policy -> technical policy-match PASS.
processes.negativeCase: One incompatible patch/interface section -> FAIL despite a matching main cable category; missing shield continuity -> unresolved.

processes.title: Bidirectional fiber loss budget
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
requiredInputs: exact wavelength/fiber attenuation and installed lengths
mated connector pairs and splice events
Tx min/max dBm, receiver sensitivity/overload dBm
requiredSensitivityMargin separate from physical attenuation interval
processes.algorithm: For each optical direction compute loss interval=sum(alpha_dB_per_km*length_m/1000 + matedPairLoss + spliceLoss + declared loss terms). RxMin=TxMin-lossMax must meet sensitivity; RxMax=TxMax-lossMin must not exceed overload. Signed dBm is allowed; dB losses nonnegative. Evaluate both directions with their exact optics. Physical loss interval excludes reserve. Sensitivity check: TxMin-lossMax >= sensitivity+requiredSensitivityMargin. Overload: TxMax-lossMin <= receiverMax; no reserve is added to lossMin. Both directions pin separate optics/wavelength/path facts.
processes.positiveOracle: Tx=-3dBm,loss=2.5dB -> Rx=-5.5dBm; sensitivity=-15/overload=-1 -> margins9.5dB/4.5dB, both PASS for symmetric declared optics.
processes.negativeCase: TxMax=-1,lossMin=0,receiverOverload=-3 -> overload FAIL even if sensitivity passes; connector ends must not double mated-pair count.

processes.title: Rack demand/capacity basis
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
requiredInputs: spare policy and available capacity if explicitly supplied
capacityBasis and explicit already-excluded reservation provenance
processes.algorithm: Sum demand from distinct equipment; report RU/weight/depth requirements and comparison only for explicit available limits. No slot placement, clearance, thermal-layout or cabinet-fit certification; those belong to ELV6. Capacity basis is GROSS_WITH_EXCLUSIONS or NET_USABLE. Gross subtracts explicit unavailable/reserved set once; net never subtracts those again and records their provenance. Equipment demand is distinct from excluded reserve. Actual slot/depth/thermal fit stays NOT_ASSESSED until ELV6.
processes.positiveOracle: Devices2RU+1RU and explicit1RU reserved -> demand4RU; declared6RU basis leaves2RU; layout status NOT_ASSESSED.
processes.negativeCase: Unknown equipment depth prevents depth comparison, not an automatic fit; missing enclosure layout cannot be hidden as PASS.

processes.title: Patch-panel utilization
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Count occupied/free/reserved physical ports with unique mapping identity; validate expected end-to-end mapping completeness. Passive continuation and termination evidence are separate relationships, not extra occupied ports.
processes.positiveOracle: 8 ports,5 occupied,2 required spare ->3 free,1 free-after-reserve; complete declared mapping -> PASS.
processes.negativeCase: Duplicate endpoint mapping or missing destination -> finding; do not count one port twice through internal and external links.

processes.title: Door role completeness
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Compare assigned canonical component roles/multiplicities with required alternatives: e.g. entry reader plus (exit reader OR exit button). Equipment may fill several roles only if explicitly allowed; do not infer emergency release from a device name.
processes.positiveOracle: Profile reader+lock+(exitReader OR exitButton); exactly reader,lock,exitButton assigned -> PASS.
processes.negativeCase: Missing required contact/release role under selected profile -> FAIL or BLOCKED when assignment unknown; no universal door template.

processes.title: Controller channel capacity
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Count unique hardware resources per channel type; compare separate reader/relay/supervised-input limits and required spare. Sharing across doors requires an explicit supported channel multiplexing model, not duplicate memberships.
processes.positiveOracle: Controller4 reader channels,3 used ->1 free;2 relay channels,2 used ->0 free; explicit zero spare -> PASS.
processes.negativeCase: Third relay assignment -> relay FAIL while reader capacity still passes.

processes.title: Lock demand and terminal voltage
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Resolve selected lock mode and explicit peak model, then consume shared PWR-01/03 including trunk loads from other consumers. Relay control is not the lock power source. Unsupported electrical model propagates BLOCKED.
processes.positiveOracle: Shared trunk .3+.5A,24V,.5ohm and lock branch .3ohm -> lock23.45V; shared trunk .8A retained.
processes.negativeCase: Control-only relay adjacency with no conductive feed -> power path unresolved; do not size by lock branch current alone.

processes.title: ACS supply requirement
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Apply calling ACS policy through source-owned requirement set; compare each dimension using the shared physical demand and reserve once. Source input demand remains distinct from capability selection margin.
processes.positiveOracle: Demand30W,reserve1.2,50W rating,derating.8 ->required36,available40,margin4; actual output demand remains30W.
processes.negativeCase: Incompatible policy requirement sets block composition; no per-door multiplication of source reserve.

processes.title: ACS backup requirement
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Use complete global protected sequence and exact model applicability; expose ACS contribution plus global requirement. State durations and any extension policy are explicit. No nominal Ah/current shortcut for unsupported models.
processes.positiveOracle: Shared constant-current source19.2W for3600s ->19.2Wh; usable134.4Wh ->115.2Wh margin for that explicit sequence.
processes.negativeCase: Missing required duration or ignored non-ACS protected load -> BLOCKED; sequence margin alone does not imply indefinite autonomy.

processes.title: Door control/supply topology
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Validate typed path roles and selected door topology alternatives independently: data/control, feed, monitoring and required emergency-release dependency. Preserve non-owning assemblies; topology reachability is not electrical capacity.
processes.positiveOracle: Explicit reader-controller link,controller relay control,independent lock supply and required exit/release path -> topology basis PASS.
processes.negativeCase: Lock connected only to dry contact without feed -> required-feed FAIL; missing selected release evidence blocks completeness.

processes.title: Fire loop device/address capacity
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
requiredInputs: device assignments and exact address/resource consumption
full expanded domain/address assignment sets including reserved resources
processes.algorithm: Count physical devices and consumed addresses separately, including modules occupying multiple addresses. Enforce declared uniqueness and scoped address domain. Compare independent device/address/panel limits. Assignments store explicit address set or versioned deterministic expansion with loop/panel address domain; expanded cardinality must equal profile consumption. Uniqueness is checked on full(domain,address) set including reserved resources, not just start address. Noncontiguous sets allowed only by selected profile.
processes.positiveOracle: 3 devices with address consumption1,1,2 ->4 addresses; declared5-address limit ->margin1.
processes.negativeCase: Duplicate loop-scoped address or exceeded module limit -> FAIL even if physical device count fits.

processes.title: Standby/alarm current
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Aggregate each active state origin once; include module/panel own current at declared boundary and expose unsupported/missing load remainder. State labels do not supply current values; signal-return participation does not duplicate a physical load.
processes.positiveOracle: 2 detectors at .01A standby + module .02A ->.04A; alarm .03+.03+.02 ->.08A for declared simultaneous state.
processes.negativeCase: One missing alarm current leaves alarm unresolved while standby known subtotal remains labelled.

processes.title: Fire electrical basis
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Consume PWR-03 for explicitly supported radial/one-CP domains and compare declared fire loop/module limits. Closed signal loop does not become a supported dual-fed power mesh. Unsupported manufacturer loop electrical model returns BLOCKED; no partial traversal masquerades as full loop solution.
processes.positiveOracle: Explicit radial notification/panel feeder24V,.5A,.2ohm ->23.9V, within declared22..26V ->physical basis PASS.
processes.negativeCase: Unsupported dual-feed loop/shared return -> BLOCKED even when FA-07 signal topology passes.

processes.title: Fire supply requirement
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Compose all applicable source-owned requirement constraints on the same physical demand; include concurrent non-fire loads if source shared. Apply reserve/derating at capability boundary once with exact provenance.
processes.positiveOracle: Explicit total24W,reserve1.25,40W available ->required30W,margin10W; no second conversion/idle addition.
processes.negativeCase: Missing auxiliary load or fire reserve policy prevents full sizing PASS.

processes.title: Fire standby/alarm backup
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
requiredInputs: exact bank and PWR-04 model evidence
processes.algorithm: Use one composed protected sequence, including physical loss and selected bank factors once. Compare required/available energy or supported Ah basis. Policy source matching is not verified national fire compliance.
processes.positiveOracle: Explicit source12W standby7200s +24W alarm1800s ->36Wh; usable134.4Wh ->98.4Wh margin. No default mandated hours.
processes.negativeCase: Duration omitted or model outside discharge/EOD applicability -> BLOCKED; never insert illustrative hours as defaults.

processes.title: Notification circuit capacity
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
requiredInputs: state/inrush current and output limit policy
processes.algorithm: Check distinct active devices, output current limit, peak applicability and terminal voltage using shared PWR evidence. Respect declared simultaneous notification policy; do not infer sound pressure/acoustic coverage.
processes.positiveOracle: 3 devices at .1A ->.3A <=declared .5A output, all terminals within provided voltage bounds ->basis PASS.
processes.negativeCase: Count fits but startup or terminal voltage fails -> per-dimension FAIL; absent acoustic model yields no acoustic claim.

processes.title: Fire signal topology integrity
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
requiredInputs: signal graph and loop source/return ports
processes.algorithm: Validate the selected directed/loop topology, required return closure, illegal branches and declared isolator placement policy on the signal layer. Isolator behavior/short-circuit survivability needs an explicit supported model; mere component presence is not proof. Consume full expanded FA-01 address sets; topological placement does not hide overlaps.
processes.positiveOracle: Declared source->D1->D2->return path closed with no forbidden branch and unique addresses ->signal basis PASS.
processes.negativeCase: Broken return/illegal branch ->FAIL; passing closure never overrides FA-03 unsupported power-loop finding.

processes.title: Fire cable policy/evidence basis
processes.numericPolicy: elv4.exact-rational.v2; bounded geometry backend where explicitly applicable
processes.algorithm: Compare declared cable/environment facts against exact selected project/profile requirements. Output policy-match and evidence completeness; verified compliance is separate and remains UNRESOLVED unless ELV7 verified applicability is actually supplied. No jurisdiction label or fictional class creates certification.
processes.positiveOracle: Fictional policy requires TEST_CLASS_A, cable explicitly TEST_CLASS_A and applicable environment evidence ->policy-match PASS; verified compliance UNRESOLVED/not claimed.
processes.negativeCase: Missing fire class or route evidence ->BLOCKED; fictional policy cannot produce VERIFIED_COMPLIANT.
